title: Renter and Driver Qualification Standard — Bluegate Moving Truck Rental
content:
**Counter qualification standard for a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract.**

1. Every driver must be at least the class minimum age and hold a licence meeting the class licence requirement, shown at the counter.
2. The renter must be the customer on the reservation.
3. The renter's age is judged from the date of birth on the customer profile — the company's record — not from the renter's own statement.
4. The deposit card must be in the renter's name.
5. One-way returns are not offered: the vehicle comes back to the facility it was picked up from.

## Age at pickup (hypothetical renter born 14 June 2005, class minimum age 21)

| Pickup date | Age from the date of birth on the profile | Meets a minimum of 21 |
|---|---|---|
| 13 June 2026 | 20 | No |
| 14 June 2026 | 21 | Yes |

The same renter meets the minimum of 18 that applies on the Bluegate Pickup Truck, Bluegate Cargo Van and Bluegate 10 ft and 15 ft Moving Trucks on either date.

## Points of judgement

- A renter whose profile shows the qualifying age but whose additional driver is younger than the class minimum: the additional driver does not meet term 1, which applies to every driver.
- A reservation made by one customer and a pickup sought by another person: the renter must be the customer on the reservation.
- A deposit card in a relative's name: it does not meet term 4.
